about_the_game:
"MESS" is a multiplayer first-person jailbreak game where strategy, deception, and survival collide in a prison environment.

Step into the role of either a Warden or a Prisoner. As Wardens, your team must maintain order, ensuring prisoners survive until their scheduled executions. Manage their needs, from hunger and health to mental challenges like asthma, diabetes, and outbreaks of disease. Use your tools wisely—batons, tasers, handcuffs, and the emergency button—to keep the chaos at bay.

Prisoners, on the other hand, have one goal: escape. They’ll need to disrupt systems, find opportunities, and avoid the Wardens to make their break for freedom. Mistakes can mean being caught or left behind.

With Wardens managing the prison and prisoners focused on breaking out, each match is a tense back-and-forth of planning and decisions. The balance between order and escape makes every session tough to manage.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 470 GTX or AMD Radeon 6870 HD
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 1050 GTX or AMD Radeon RX-460
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
